meta.name: Kiseki Miracle Season
meta.description: When four boys meet on a Tokyo trip, their lives quietly intertwine—leading to love, growth, and a winter that might bring them back together.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After much begging from Beboy, P finally agrees to let the twins Pan and Plai stay in his house.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The gang spend the night drinking together, with Pan and Plai playing songs they had written.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The four of them get closer as they play a card game, and the connections between them become stronger.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In order to deepen their cultural understanding, P takes the group to see the Tokyo Tower and to experience an onsen.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As the Tokyo trip comes to an end, everyone feels reluctant to leave, while Beboy seems to have something he wants to say to Plai.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Before heading off to the airport, P takes the boys on another tour of the city, taking the chance to share what they've been thinking about.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: P reunites with Pan in Japan—but one touch from a stranger sparks a storm of jealousy.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: P hides his jealousy as Pan grows close to a young artist—until one quiet moment shifts everything.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After a romantic day, P kisses Pan—unaware their moment is secretly caught on camera.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Leaked photos and misunderstandings drive Pan away—leaving P to search and make things right.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: P and Pan reconcile on the beach—and in one room, share a question about their future.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Pan wakes in P’s arms, but doubts linger as P’s love remains unspoken—and challenged.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: P confesses at the mirror pond—and Pan says yes. A birthday surprise changes everything.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Love is sealed in laughter and Thai costumes—P and Pan declare every season theirs.
